page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

l.i: tuò auxilio sint: Turbat.e pacis gravis multa
sta fit aureorum scutatorum mille, aut pœna
capitis, si quis multam solvere non queat:
vis omnis absit, non armis, sed judicio con-
mantur: æris alieni solutio expediatur: in
alios, qui cum civitate fœdus habent: qui
in legationem ad senatum non consensere per
ij, qui sunt prius nominati, fœdere hoc non
sint comprehensi: fœdus valeat in annos xxx.

main_text.l: quod id expedire in initio videretur, in
es ibi parta: anno postero domus præ-
fecto structa. Post hæc, cùm diffidia &
torum simultas ex invidiâ & metu glisce-
ret, ne quid indè majoris exisseret mali,

page.notes: Printed "Collumanum" in the text has a damaged initial letter; read as C. "Turbat.e" printed with a stop inside the word. Printed "M.CCCC.LXVII" uses C and V as printed, not reversed C. The margin note's first word is read as "Fedus" with a damaged F. "tandem" at lower right is a catchword. The faint "Digitized" line at bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
